title: ARIES-Mission: A Vision-Language System for Auditable UAV Mission Generation
description: Version 3.1.0: existing ARIES-Mission mission-routing implementation, complete formal classical and matched-compute controls, runtime calibration, statistical and figure-generation scripts, tests and frozen evidence. Controlled experiments isolate geometric routing from semantic grounding. No new experiments are introduced.
